title: Discount with non-negative final price
intent: Implement apply_discount. Price must be non negative. Discount percent must be between 0 and 100 inclusive. Final price must never be negative.
critic_improved_spec: Apply a discount only when price is non negative and discount percent is between 0 and 100. The final price must never be negative.
missing_requirements: Discount percent must be between 0 and 100
Final price must never be negative
expected_naive_failure: The naive public spec can select an implementation that applies arithmetic without validating discount bounds.
expected_defense: The omission-aware critic spec should reject discounts below 0 or above 100 and reject negative prices.

public_spec_text.critic: Apply a discount only when price is non negative and discount percent is between 0 and 100. The final price must never be negative.
public_spec_text.oracle: Apply a discount only when price is non negative and discount percent is between 0 and 100. The final price must never be negative.
